page.overview:
Who is The Autobahn Society?

"These high-powered rollers known as The Autobahn Society fly the world in executive fashion to lay stakes against the greatest cars on the circuit. It's not uncommon for these gentlemen to bet a small fortune on everything from who will win the race, to who will come in last, and every place in between."

Their collective name is a pun on the National Audubon Society, a non-profit organization dedication to the conservation of birds, and the German Autobahn highway system.
